scope: Specify the existing concurrency policy and close active-overlap test gaps. Runtime and dependencies are unchanged.

policy.fail_fast: Uncaught failure stops that script; CLI batches finish every admitted and queued sibling. Handled errors can succeed. No batch fail-fast flag.
policy.cancellation: Embedded runs with independent controls can be stopped individually. Separate children of one parent isolate sibling cancellation. Operation captures and pools remain shared.

exit_status.0: All runs and status delivery succeeded
exit_status.1: At least one run or reporter failed

policy.output: Within-run execution order and whole Log/status records; unspecified cross-run Log order and terminal collection order; no cross-stream ordering guarantee.
policy.reporting_failure: Stop queued admission, drain admitted runs, suppress later records, and return failure.

tests.name: linux::script_failure_keeps_admitted_and_queued_siblings_running
tests.mechanism: Connect two admitted source FIFOs with --jobs 2, verify a third remains queued, then supply a script that logs 10, fails on missing, and must skip Log 999. The third FIFO must enter after the failure while the second remains blocked. Release both siblings, including a handled error in the third, and verify preserved output, exactly-once status records, two successes/one failure, exit 1.
tests.cleanup: Child guard kills/reaps on failure; FIFO handles close on unwind.

tests.name: cancelling_one_active_run_releases_only_its_shared_operation_reservations
tests.mechanism: Wait for two nested DSL calls into one shared NativeOperation. Cancel one sibling control only after both enter. Verify Cancelled, handler/tail bypass, retained earlier binding, first Drop, live sibling reservation/control, unchanged parent, then release the sibling and verify success and zero shared charges.
tests.cleanup: Async resource Drop counters and operation usage are checked explicitly.

test_sensitivity_probes.scope: Two test-sensitivity probes only; not a replacement for the fixed mutation campaign or a project mutation score.
test_sensitivity_probes.replay: In an isolated checkout of this revision, run each exact test command unmodified. Apply its before/after substitution exactly once, run the recorded build then exact test, and restore the source. Baselines must pass; mutated builds must succeed and tests must report assertion failures. Command watchdog timeouts or compiler failures do not count as caught; these tests use bounded handshake assertions to reject missing progress.

boundaries: No CLI per-run cancellation command, signal coordination, batch fail-fast switch, or hard shutdown guarantee was added.
Started blocking work must still return. Async Drop tests do not prove bounded cleanup for arbitrary adapters or blocked syscalls.
Session/report/artifact isolation, immutable module caching, adapter-specific sharing, 1000-run stress, and performance measurements remain separate TODOs.
The FIFO test is Linux-only; no new non-Linux platform claim. Hosted CI was not observed.

Prior worker-startup Unverified/NotStarted observation in docs/async-execution-evidence.json and musl debug timing sensitivity in docs/nonblocking-io-evidence.json remain historical open observations. No failure occurred in these four full-suite runs.
